meta.title: Subnational population projections, 2022-based (principal)
meta.next_update: Unknown (SNPP normally every 2 years; next likely 2024-based)
meta.quality: Official statistics (ONS); projections, not forecasts. They assume recent trends in births, deaths and migration continue and do not model local policy or development (e.g. housing growth or a resort opening).
meta.limitations: Base year 2022; base pre-dates the mid-2023 to mid-2025 MYEs so early projection years will not match published estimates. Migration assumptions dominate at LA level and 18-24 counts are sensitive to student migration. No uncertainty intervals at LA level.
